result.description: Compact 27-inch desktop display designed for reading, writing, and ambient control panels. The Echo Panel 27 uses an IPS-style LED panel with a matte finish, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 75 Hz refresh rate, and a built-in ambient light sensor for automatic brightness tuning. It includes dual HDMI inputs, one USB-C upstream port, and integrated stereo speakers for everyday office or studio use. The stand supports tilt, swivel, and height adjustment, while the ultra-thin bezel makes it suitable for multi-monitor workspaces.
